SELECT forecast_run_id, client_request_id, trigger_type, base_date, model_version_id, azure_job_id, run_status, current_stage, total_batches, total_items, received_batches, received_items FROM demand_forecast_run WHERE azure_job_id = #{azureJobId} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET model_version_id = COALESCE(model_version_id, #{modelVersionId}), total_batches = COALESCE(total_batches, #{totalBatches}), total_items = COALESCE(total_items, #{totalItems,jdbcType=NUMERIC}), current_stage = 'IMPORTING', import_requested_at = COALESCE(import_requested_at, SYSTIMESTAMP), updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND base_date = #{baseDate} AND (model_version_id IS NULL OR model_version_id = #{modelVersionId}) AND (total_batches IS NULL OR total_batches = #{totalBatches}) AND (#{totalItems,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR total_items IS NULL OR total_items = #{totalItems,jdbcType=NUMERIC})

INSERT INTO demand_forecast_staging ( forecast_run_id, batch_number, sku_id, sales_point_id, predicted_qty_d7, predicted_qty_d14, predicted_qty_d30, predicted_qty_d60, predicted_qty_d90, forecast_source, confidence_level, created_at, created_by )
SELECT CAST(#{forecast.forecastRunId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{forecast.batchNumber} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{forecast.skuId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{forecast.salesPointId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{forecast.predictedQtyD7} AS NUMBER(15,3)), CAST(#{forecast.predictedQtyD14} AS NUMBER(15,3)), CAST(#{forecast.predictedQtyD30} AS NUMBER(15,3)), CAST(#{forecast.predictedQtyD60} AS NUMBER(15,3)), CAST(#{forecast.predictedQtyD90} AS NUMBER(15,3)), CAST(#{forecast.forecastSource} AS VARCHAR2(40)), CAST(#{forecast.confidenceLevel} AS VARCHAR2(10)), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CAST(#{forecast.createdBy} AS NUMBER) FROM dual

INSERT INTO demand_forecast_import_batch ( forecast_run_id, batch_number, item_count, payload_hash, received_at, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{batchNumber}, #{itemCount}, #{payloadHash}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET total_items = COALESCE(total_items, #{totalItems,jdbcType=NUMERIC}), received_batches = #{receivedBatches}, received_items = #{receivedItems}, current_stage = CASE WHEN #{receivedBatches} = total_batches THEN 'FINALIZING' ELSE 'IMPORTING' END, all_batches_received_at = CASE WHEN #{receivedBatches} = total_batches THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE all_batches_received_at END, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND (#{totalItems,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR total_items IS NULL OR total_items = #{totalItems,jdbcType=NUMERIC})

UPDATE demand_forecast target SET target.is_deleted = 1, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_by = #{userId} WHERE target.is_deleted = 0 AND (target.model_version_id, target.base_date) IN ( SELECT run.model_version_id, run.base_date FROM demand_forecast_run run WHERE run.forecast_run_id = #{runId} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM demand_forecast_staging staging WHERE staging.forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND staging.sku_id = target.sku_id AND staging.sales_point_id = target.sales_point_id )

MERGE INTO demand_forecast target USING ( SELECT staging.forecast_run_id, staging.sku_id, staging.sales_point_id, run.model_version_id, run.base_date, staging.predicted_qty_d7, staging.predicted_qty_d14, staging.predicted_qty_d30, staging.predicted_qty_d60, staging.predicted_qty_d90, staging.forecast_source, staging.confidence_level FROM demand_forecast_staging staging INNER JOIN demand_forecast_run run ON run.forecast_run_id = staging.forecast_run_id WHERE staging.forecast_run_id = #{runId} ) source ON (target.sku_id = source.sku_id AND target.sales_point_id = source.sales_point_id AND target.model_version_id = source.model_version_id AND target.base_date = source.base_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.forecast_run_id = source.forecast_run_id, target.predicted_qty_d7 = source.predicted_qty_d7, target.predicted_qty_d14 = source.predicted_qty_d14, target.predicted_qty_d30 = source.predicted_qty_d30, target.predicted_qty_d60 = source.predicted_qty_d60, target.predicted_qty_d90 = source.predicted_qty_d90, target.forecast_source = source.forecast_source, target.confidence_level = source.confidence_level, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_by = #{userId}, target.is_deleted = 0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (forecast_run_id, sku_id, sales_point_id, model_version_id, base_date, predicted_qty_d7, predicted_qty_d14, predicted_qty_d30, predicted_qty_d60, predicted_qty_d90, forecast_source, confidence_level, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted) VALUES (source.forecast_run_id, source.sku_id, source.sales_point_id, source.model_version_id, source.base_date, source.predicted_qty_d7, source.predicted_qty_d14, source.predicted_qty_d30, source.predicted_qty_d60, source.predicted_qty_d90, source.forecast_source, source.confidence_level, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userId}, #{userId}, 0)

UPDATE demand_forecast_run SET run_status = 'SUCCEEDED', current_stage = NULL, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE forecast_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND current_stage = 'FINALIZING' AND received_batches = total_batches AND received_items = total_items
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT df.forecast_id, df.sku_id, s.sku_name, df.sales_point_id, sp.sales_point_name, df.model_version_id, model.model_version, df.base_date, df.predicted_qty_d7, df.predicted_qty_d14, df.predicted_qty_d30, df.predicted_qty_d60, df.predicted_qty_d90, df.forecast_source, df.confidence_level, df.created_at, df.updated_at, df.created_by, df.updated_by, df.is_deleted FROM demand_forecast df INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = df.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = df.sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ml_model_version model ON model.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND model.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode} AND df.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ip.safety_stock_qty FROM inventory_policy ip INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ip.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = COALESCE(ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id) AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ip.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL AND ip.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) AND ip.is_deleted = 0 AND (ip.effective_from IS NULL OR ip.effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (ip.effective_to IS NULL OR ip.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ip.effective_from DESC, ip.inventory_policy_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT NVL(SUM(ib.on_hand_qty), 0) FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = COALESCE(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) AND ib.is_deleted = 0

SELECT SUM(policy.safety_stock_qty) FROM ( SELECT ip.safety_stock_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ip.sku_id, COALESCE(ip.stock_sales_point_id, ip.allocated_sales_point_id, -1) ORDER BY ip.effective_from DESC, ip.inventory_policy_id DESC ) AS rn FROM inventory_policy ip INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ip.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ip.is_deleted = 0 AND (ip.effective_from IS NULL OR ip.effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (ip.effective_to IS NULL OR ip.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ) policy WHERE policy.rn = 1
SELECT NVL(SUM(ib.on_hand_qty), 0) FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ib.is_deleted = 0

WITH latest_by_sales_point AS ( SELECT df.*, s.sku_name, model.model_version, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) AS rn FROM demand_forecast df INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = df.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ml_model_version model ON model.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND model.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND df.is_deleted = 0 ), selected AS ( SELECT * FROM latest_by_sales_point WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT NULL AS forecast_id, MAX(sku_id) AS sku_id, MAX(sku_name) AS sku_name, NULL AS sales_point_id, '전체 판매처' AS sales_point_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN MAX(model_version_id) END AS model_version_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN MAX(model_version) END AS model_version, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN MAX(base_date) END AS base_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN SUM(predicted_qty_d7) END AS predicted_qty_d7, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN SUM(predicted_qty_d14) END AS predicted_qty_d14, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN SUM(predicted_qty_d30) END AS predicted_qty_d30, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN SUM(predicted_qty_d60) END AS predicted_qty_d60, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT model_version_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT base_date) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN SUM(predicted_qty_d90) END AS predicted_qty_d90, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT forecast_source) = 1 THEN MAX(forecast_source) END AS forecast_source, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT confidence_level) = 1 THEN MAX(confidence_level) END AS confidence_level, MAX(created_at) AS created_at, MAX(updated_at) AS updated_at, NULL AS created_by, NULL AS updated_by, 0 AS is_deleted FROM selected HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
